Procedures for the Exchange Program
Email nomination - Online Application and document submission(Link will be provided to the students) - Acceptance Notice
Nomination Deadlines
Spring Semester: October 30th
Fall Semester: April 30th
Application Deadlines
Spring Semester: November 30th
Fall Semester: May 30th
Academic Term Dates
Spring Semester: March to June
Fall Semester: September to December
Exchange Period
1 Semester or 1 Academic Year(2 Semesters)
Level of Study
Undergraduate level ONLY
Exchange Program Track & Language Requirements
[Korean track]
TOPIK (Korean Language Proficiency Test) Level 3 or higher (Level 4 or higher for College of Business Administration)
OR
Korean major students: A Letter of Language Proficiency from the Dean of Korean Language Department(Sophomore or higher)
* Requirements for Korean track will be raised to a minimum of
TOPIK level 5 or higher OR (for Korean Language majors) A Letter of Language Proficiency written by the Dean of the Korean Language Department
[English track]
TOEFL IBT 82 / IELTS 6.5 or higher recommended

Course Information / Syllabus
https://sugang.khu.ac.kr/
Change language to 'English' and go to 'Course Schedule Index'
*Please NOTE:
- Bilingual courses are mainly taught in Korean with English materials.
- Students are responsible for checking the availability of English-taught courses and their prerequisites in advance.
- The availability of English-taught courses may vary across departments.
- List of courses and syllabi are progressively updated two months before the semester starts.
- Students may be unable to enroll in certain desired courses due to internal restrictions (e.g. some classes may only be available to regular degree-seeking students)
Recommended Credit Load
3~5(9~15 credits) courses per semester
Minimum-Maximum Workload
3~6(9~18 credits) courses per semester
Undergraduate Grading Scale
4.3
Minimum GPA Requirement
2.5 out of 4.0 or above
Application Requirements
Students must be nominated officially by their home institution before submitting all the required documents online and via email
Students must complete the online application before the deadline
Required documents(for Application)
Students must be nominated officially by their home institution before submitting all the required documents online and email
Students of Non-OECD nationality must submit a hard copy of their Certificate of Enrollment (with Apostille or Consular Authentication) and Official Bank Statement according to Korea's immigration regulations.
[Online Submission via Online Platform-by (Spring Term)November 30 / (Fall Term) May 30]
1) Full-size color copy of Passport(including the signature page)
2) Scanned ID Photo(3.5x4.5cm, colored, scanned in white background) for your student ID card and Registration Card
* You might need it for your visa application too.
3) Certificate of Enrolment(English)
4) Official Academic Transcript(English)
5) Recommendation Letter from your academic advisor or professor
6) (
KHU Form
)
Personal Statement including your Study Plan(Korean or English)
* You must state your major at your home institution
7) (KHU Form) Medical Assessment
8) (KHU Form) GPA Conversion & Academic Capability Confirmation
9) Korean Language Proficiency Document (Korean Track Only)
- TOPIK Score : Level 3 or higher ; level 4 or higher to take courses at the College of Business Administration)
- For those who are majoring in Korean language, but do not have a TOPIK score : A letter of language proficiency from Dean of the Korean Language Department at your home university
[Online Submission via Google Form-Specific deadlines TBA]
1) Official Bank Statement(Over 5,000 USD per semester, 9,000 USD per year)
* It can be your guardian's account as long as you show us an official document showing the person's relationship with you.
* Students who study for 1 year(2 semesters) must certify 9,000 USD.
2) Insurance Certification
* It must cover your entire mobility period.
* From March 1st 2021, the Korean government made foreign students studying in Korea mandatorily purchase the NHI for which
you can only register after entering Korea.
* We do not want you enter Korea without the insurance, unprotected. Having insurance that covers your travel and
during the gap period before the NHI registration is crucial.

Insurance
*Fee is subject to change
Students must obtain their overseas insurance in their home country BEFORE they enter Korea. After coming to Korea, students are OBLIGED to obtain National Health Insurance(Monthly fee: KRW72,000)
Visa Requirements
Students must obtain D-2-6(Exchange Student Visa) BEFORE they enter Korea
* D-2-8(Short-term Study Visa) for visiting students
Campus Facilities
Dormitory, Library, Cafeteria, Performance Hall, Medical Centre and University Hospital, etc.
Check out the Online Campus Tour Video for International Students!
Distance between each Campus (Seoul & Global)
The campuses are approximately 1.5 to 2 hours apart by car. University shuttle buses run between campuses on weekdays during the semester.
Distance from Airport
It takes around 1 to 1.5 hours by car from Incheon International Airport(ICN) to both campuses
Arrival & Orientation
Further information will be sent to final candidates via email.
Things you have to prepare upon arrival
Spare Money to adjust your life in Seoul eg: Transportation fee, Commission fee when you get official documents and possibly for COVID-19 Test
Copies of your documents eg: Passport, Insurance Policy
Photos: Can be used for Dormitory application, Registration Card, Visa Issuance
Pillow and blanket: For those who stay in Sewha hall.
SIM card: Required to get one at the airport
Download Kakaotalk Application: Group chat will be created after the orientation
Required documents(for ARC)
1) Application form
2) Copy of Passport
3) Visa Grant Notice
You can get it from the website
(click)
4) Photo
The size of 3.5*4.5, white background, colored, head shot(selfie not allowed)
5) Proof of Residency
- Living on-campus:
Residence Confirmation
from Office of International Affairs or Sehwa hall Dormitory office
- Living off-campus: Copy of rental contract
If the contract is not under the applicant’s name, it is required to submit the copy of accommodation provider’s ID card &
Confirmation of Residence/Accommodation
* Forms will be provided to students at a later date
6) Certificate of Enrollment
7) Application fee
30,000 KRW(in cash)
Grading / Credit Transfer
Grading is based on attendance, class discussion, homework, and examinations KHU regulations require a minimum of 70% attendance to receive academic credit
* 1 course = 1~3 credits = 16~48 lecture hours
E.g.) 3 credits course x 16 weeks = 48 lecture hours
